_about: Price Check data (daily/price-check-plan.md). One entry per exact model we recommend. All figures are prices seen at stores other than Amazon, or list prices, each with its source and date; never an Amazon price (Associates Program Policies 2(b), 6(y)). 'good' and 'great' are our own lines; 'verdict' is buy (buy now), ok (fair price, no reason to wait) or wait (a sale is likely soon). Change 'checked' only when the entry was really re-checked.

items.name: ThermoWorks ThermoPop 2
items.model: ThermoPop 2 (not the original ThermoPop or the Thermapen ONE).
items.why: Thanksgiving is November 26 and you want time to test it in ice water. ThermoWorks ran it at $31 (20% off) on July 1, 2026, so 20–30% off happens, but not reliably before the holiday.
items.sources: ThermoWorks via America's Test Kitchen, July 1, 2026; ThermoWorks list price, October 2026

items.name: Instant Pot Duo 6-Quart 7-in-1
items.model: Duo 6-quart, model IP-DUO60 or 112-0170-01; not the Duo Plus or the 8-quart.
items.street: List $109.99 at Instant Pot's store; no sale on the day (Oct 21, 2026)
items.why: Black Friday is November 27. Reported 2025 sale depth was 36% off for the Duo 6-quart (Bob Vila, Nov 28, 2025) and 30%–40% in earlier years, so 30% off or better is the line.
items.sources: Instant Pot store list price, Oct 21, 2026; Bob Vila Black Friday 2025 deals (Nov 28, 2025); Slickdeals comment (Mar 2025)

items.name: Ninja AF101 4-Quart Air Fryer
items.model: AF101, 4 quarts; check the model number, Ninja sells several similar baskets.
items.street: List $119.99; $89.99 at Best Buy, Target and Home Depot (Apr 1, 2026)
items.why: Home Depot took 32% off Ninja kitchen appliances on Black Friday 2025, which would put it near $82; a few dollars lower is our buy line.
items.sources: Slickdeals price tracker, Apr 1, 2026; NBC Select Black Friday 2025

items.name: KitchenAid Artisan 5-Quart Stand Mixer
items.model: Artisan KSM150, 5-quart tilt-head; colours differ in price, so compare the same colour.
items.street: List $499.99; $349 at Target and $242.29 at Lowe's (Oct 6, 2025)
items.why: It sells 25–30% below list in most big sales, and Lowe's went near half off in October 2025.
items.sources: TechRadar (list); Slickdeals, Oct 6, 2025; Walmart listing (undated)

items.name: Rubbermaid Brilliance Leak-Proof Containers
items.model: Brilliance plastic sets; count the pieces, because set sizes differ by store.
items.street: Mid-teens to about $20 on sale; Target $39.99 at list (July 5, 2026)
items.why: Target took about 40% off in the Black Friday week last year; at list price it is poor value.
items.sources: Slickdeals posts, Nov 20, 2025 and July 5, 2026; BJ's, July 2026

items.name: Owala FreeSip 24 oz
items.model: FreeSip 24 oz stainless (the 32 oz lists at $35–$40).
items.why: Under $25 has been easy to find all autumn; Owala.com's 20% sitewide sale last Black Friday matched it, and no 2026 Black Friday Owala deal was announced as of October 24, so there is little to wait for.
items.sources: Slickdeals trackers, Sep 6 and Oct 1, 2026; Owala.com sale, Nov 26 – Dec 1, 2025; NBC News Select, Nov 2025

items.name: Bissell Little Green 1400B
items.model: 1400B (corded classic); the Little Green Cordless and the Pet Pro are different machines.
items.why: Walmart listed it at $74.62 on October 7, 2026, about what last year's Black Friday cut (around 31% off list) reached, so there is little to wait for. No 2026 Black Friday price was announced as of October 25.
items.sources: Slickdeals, Oct 7, 2026 (Walmart); CNN Underscored, Nov 19, 2025; Bissell list price

items.name: O-Cedar EasyWring Spin Mop
items.model: EasyWring 1-tank system (mop, bucket, one head); the RinseClean 2-tank is a different, pricier set.
items.why: It rarely moves much below $35; the better saving is a bundle with refill heads, which Costco has sold near $26.
items.sources: Slickdeals, Aug 20, 2026; Costco bundle, July 2025

items.name: Roborock Saros 10R
items.model: Saros 10R (the Saros 20 replaced it on March 23, 2026; the Saros 10 without the R is a different robot).
items.why: October already beat last year's Black Friday price of $999.99, and as a replaced model it has less room to fall.
items.sources: Roborock store, Oct 14, 2026; 9to5Google, Black Friday 2025

items.name: Dreame X50 Ultra
items.model: X50 Ultra (the X60 Max Ultra Complete replaced it in February 2026).
items.why: Dreame's own store ran it at $799.99 (50% off) from November 20 to December 1, 2025; expect a clearance-style price again.
items.sources: Dreame Black Friday 2025 post (search snippet)

items.name: Levoit Core 300-P Air Purifier
items.model: Core 300-P; its filter is the genuine Core 300-RF.
items.why: Home Depot ran it near $49 in some stores in November 2025 (prices varied by region), so the Black Friday week is the time to check.
items.sources: Slickdeals threads, Nov 6 and Nov 26, 2025; retailer pages, Sept 2026

items.name: Bedsure Heated Throw 50 x 60
items.model: 50 x 60 in throw with the 8-hour auto-off; check the label against the March 2023 CPSC recall before first use.
items.street: Heated throws run about $20–$80; Walmart about $32 (Oct 1, 2026)
items.why: Sales take 30–45% off, but the everyday price is already low; buy when it is cold, not for the deal.
items.sources: Walmart listing, Oct 1, 2026

items.name: Beckham Hotel Collection Pillows (pair)
items.model: Standard/Queen set of 2 (King costs more).
items.street: About $40–$60 for the pair at major retailers
items.why: 30–40% cuts show up outside Black Friday too (Woot sold a pair at $34.99); there is no reason to wait weeks.
items.sources: Walmart listings (2026); Woot, March 2023

items.name: Dreo 1500W Ceramic Space Heater
items.model: Dreo 1500W PTC ceramic oscillating heater with thermostat and remote.
items.why: Walmart ran $29.99–$43.99 from November 2025 to January 2026. If you are cold now, under $45 is fine.
items.sources: dreo.com, Oct 15, 2026; Walmart deals, Nov 2025 – Jan 2026

items.name: NOCO Boost Plus GB40
items.model: GB40, 1000A, for gas engines up to 6.0 liters (the GB50 is the bigger one).
items.why: About $80 has been the usual deal price for two years (Woot, Aug 26, 2025); it does not usually go lower, so there is nothing to wait for before winter.
items.sources: NOCO list price; Slickdeals, Aug 26, 2025

items.name: REDTIGER F7NP 4K Dash Cam
items.model: F7NP front and rear; the bundle with a 128GB card costs more than the camera alone.
items.street: Brand list $149.98 with card, $129.99 without; street about $100–$130
items.why: The crossed-out $149.98 is not the real street price; $100 or less is where it is a good buy.
items.sources: Android Authority, Jul 28, 2026; redtigercam.com, Oct 2026

items.name: ChomChom Roller
items.model: The original ChomChom Roller (look-alikes copy the shape, not the comb).
items.why: 20–30% off is common and 40% off is rare; it is already near the usual low.
items.sources: PetSmart, Oct 2026; Walmart, Sept 2026

items.name: KONG Classic (Large)
items.model: Classic red KONG, Large for 30–65 lb dogs (black is the Extreme).
items.why: It is cheap all year; size matters more than price.
items.sources: Chewy and Walmart, Sept 2026

items.name: Litter-Robot 4
items.model: Litter-Robot 4 (the EVO is a cheaper, different machine).
items.why: The price held at $699 all year; Costco's $699.99 bundle adds extras. Reconditioned units save $100 with a shorter warranty.
items.sources: litter-robot.com, 2026; Costco, July 2026

items.name: LUXE Bidet NEO 185
items.model: NEO 185 dual nozzle (the 185 Plus costs a few dollars more; the NEO 120 has one nozzle).
items.why: It sits near its floor all year, so a wait saves only a few dollars.
items.sources: LUXE store, Oct 2026; Walmart listing (undated)

items.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3
items.model: AirPods Pro 3 (2025); the AirPods 4 and Pro 2 are older models.
items.why: About $180 is already below last year's Black Friday low of $219.99.
items.sources: apple.com; TechBuzz, Nov 20, 2025; Slickdeals price table, Oct 5, 2026

items.name: Apple AirTag 2 (4-pack)
items.model: AirTag 2nd generation, 4-pack (a single is $29 list).
items.why: It launched in January 2026, so there is no Black Friday record; the deepest cut reported so far is about 19% off list (Aug 24, 2026), and $80 would match it.
items.sources: MacRumors, Aug 24, 2026; 9to5Toys, Aug 2026; The Points Guy, Oct 2026

items.name: Sony WF-1000XM6
items.model: WF-1000XM6 (2026); the XM5 is last year's model and much cheaper.
items.why: The best discount so far was about 22% off list (Oct 5, 2026); a first Black Friday usually matches or beats it.
items.sources: SoundGuys, Oct 5, 2026

items.name: Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2
items.model: C1000 Gen 2 (the first C1000 charges more slowly).
items.why: Anker's own store sold it for $429 with a code in April 2026, so it has room to fall.
items.sources: Slickdeals, Apr 23, 2026

items.name: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2
items.model: Explorer 2000 v2 (2,042 Wh); the 2000 Plus is a different, heavier unit.
items.why: Wellbots sold it for $599 with a code on November 14, 2025: the clearest Black Friday-window low of our picks.
items.sources: Slickdeals, Nov 14, 2025

items.name: Furhaven Orthopedic Sofa Dog Bed (Large)
items.model: Large (36 x 27 x 6.5 in, size guide up to 55 lb); the Quilted style is thinner than the Plush & Suede Full Support.
items.street: Quilted $39.99 (Target, Oct 19, 2026); Plush & Suede $54.99 (PetSmart, Oct 19, 2026), list $65.99
items.why: Prices barely move between stores; a deal post showed 31% off a Plush & Suede on Nov 27, 2025. Under $45 is fine for the Large.
items.sources: Target and PetSmart pages, Oct 19, 2026; Slickdeals, Nov 27, 2025

items.name: Instant Pot Duo Plus 6-Quart 9-in-1 (Whisper Quiet)
items.model: Duo Plus 6-quart Whisper Quiet, model 112-0169-01; not Target's 6QT 9-in-1 bundle (112-2356-01) or the older V3 (112-0156-01).
items.why: Reported Black Friday 2025 depth was 57% off for the Duo Plus (Bob Vila, Nov 28, 2025; pressurecookrecipes.com). Black Friday is November 27, so wait unless you need it now.
items.sources: Instant Pot store list price, Oct 21, 2026; Bob Vila (Nov 28, 2025); pressurecookrecipes.com Black Friday 2025 tally

items.name: ThermoWorks ThermoPop 2
items.model: ThermoPop 2 (not the original ThermoPop).
items.street: About $39 list at ThermoWorks, October 2026; $35 at launch (2022)
items.why: Thanksgiving is November 26. ThermoWorks ran it at $31 (20% off) on July 1, 2026 and at $24.50 (30% off) on October 5, 2023, but not reliably before the holiday, and you want time for an ice-bath test.
items.sources: ThermoWorks list price, October 2026; ThermoWorks via America's Test Kitchen, July 1, 2026; TVWBB, October 5, 2023

items.name: ThermoWorks Thermapen ONE
items.model: Thermapen ONE, any colour (the NANO is a different, newer model).
items.street: $74 in colour closeout at ThermoWorks (Oct 23, 2026); $109 list
items.why: It is being closed out, so colours are running out; ThermoWorks has sold it at $62 to $76 several times (Black Friday 2022, 2024, Nov 10, 2025), but this year's successor may change that.
items.sources: thermoworks.com, Oct 23, 2026; Slickdeals, Nov 10, 2025 and Aug 21, 2026; TVWBB Black Friday 2022 thread

items.name: Fanttik X8 Apex
items.model: X8 Apex (150 psi, built-in battery); the Deluxe package adds a case and a car adapter.
items.street: $89.99 at fanttik.com (list $99.99, Oct 26, 2026); Walmart search results showed it from about $70 (not confirmed live)
items.why: Seen at $70 at Best Buy in March 2025 and from about $70 at Walmart; the brand store is $20 higher, and no Black Friday terms were announced yet.
items.sources: fanttik.com, Oct 26, 2026; Slickdeals (Best Buy), Mar 22, 2025; Walmart search result, undated

items.name: Milwaukee M18 inflator 2848-20
items.model: 2848-20, tool only (no battery or charger).
items.street: $199 at Home Depot (Dec 2024); $149 at Walmart (search result, undated)
items.why: Home Depot ran it as a free gift with an M18 starter kit in July 2026 and in the 2025 Black Friday promotions; the Oct 29 holiday sales may repeat that.
items.sources: ShopSavvy, Dec 3, 2024; Slickdeals (Home Depot), Jul 15, 2026; ToolGuyd, Dec 2025

items.name: DeWalt 20V MAX inflator DCC020IB
items.model: DCC020IB, tool only (battery, charger and AC adapter sold separately).
items.why: It has dropped 35% at Lowe's before and Lowe's said Black Friday pricing starts Oct 29, 2026.
items.sources: Slickdeals price tracker, Apr 2026; Slickdeals (Lowe's), Nov 7, 2025; ToolGuyd, Oct 2026

items.name: AstroAI L7 cordless inflator
items.model: L7 pocket inflator (built-in battery); other AstroAI models differ.
items.street: AstroAI cordless inflators were $14.99–$44.99 in Walmart listings and deal posts in 2026
items.why: Cheap enough that waiting saves little; deal posts show frequent coupon prices.
items.sources: Slickdeals (Walmart), Aug 28, 2026; Walmart search results, 2026

items.name: Hopkins SubZero 26 in snow brush and scraper
items.model: SubZero 26 in brush with integrated scraper (the Quick Lock pivoting broom is a related model).
items.street: $27.99 at Tractor Supply for the Quick Lock broom (Bob Vila, Jan 6, 2026); $24.94 at Walmart for a 26 in SubZero (snippet, maker unconfirmed)
items.why: Cheap and rarely discounted; no sourced Black Friday percent for scrapers, so buy when you need it.
items.sources: Bob Vila best ice scrapers, Jan 2026; Walmart listing snippet, Oct 2026

items.name: Suncast Telescoping Auto Shovel SCS4506PK
items.model: SCS4506PK telescoping car shovel.
items.street: No confirmed US price found; folding car shovels ran about $15–$30 (Harbor Freight utility shovel $14.99, Oct 28, 2026; Walmart Garant about $25, snippet)
items.why: We could not confirm this model's price; compare with a metal-bladed folding shovel at about $15 at Harbor Freight.
items.sources: Harbor Freight page, Oct 28, 2026; Walmart snippet

items.name: MAXSA Escaper Buddy traction mats 20333
items.model: 2-pack, 48 in mats, model 20333.
items.street: $129.99 at Home Depot (snippet); $249.99 at Tractor Supply online (snippet)
items.why: A $120 spread on one SKU means checking the seller; coarse sand at about $8 does most of the job, so skip unless your driveway needs it.
items.sources: Home Depot and Tractor Supply listing snippets, Oct 2026; Sakrete sand $7.98 at Home Depot (NBC Select, Sept 24, 2026)

items.name: Black Diamond Astro 300 headlamp
items.model: Astro 300 (3 AAA), not the rechargeable 300-R.
items.street: No confirmed price found; Black Diamond Spot 400 about $49.95 at REI (snippet); Harbor Freight Braun 500 lumen $12.99 (Oct 28, 2026)
items.why: Price not confirmed; a $13 Harbor Freight headlamp is a fair budget alternative for one winter job.
items.sources: REI snippet; Harbor Freight page, Oct 28, 2026

items.name: Wool-blend blanket (Rothco) plus foil emergency blanket
items.model: Rothco European surplus style wool blanket; Coleman foil emergency blanket.
items.street: $53.99 at Rothco (snippet); $23.99 on eBay (snippet); Coleman foil blanket $9.12 at Walmart (snippet, undated)
items.why: Wool is the warmth; foil is a light add-on. Prices are snippets, so check the live page.
items.sources: Rothco, eBay and Walmart snippets, Oct 2026
